the_boilerplate: The deterministic abstention narrative reads: 'If you meant a specific entity, name it or give its id (e.g. T1566, M1017, or CAPEC-98).' The judge treats those three illustrative identifiers as fabricated claims. They are the abstention template, not an answer.
direction_of_bias: It inflates hallucination counts in proportion to how often an arm abstains, so it penalises the generic arm hardest -- the arm that wins C-023.
